Detailed sizing math and a 6-block build; says it was researched, not tested

missing: Hands-on testing of specific components (LiFePO4 batteries, MPPT controllers, DC-DC chargers, panels) and an authoritative wiring and fusing safety reference. None of the sources shows real measured van performance or which brands are reliable.
why: No major reviewer or authority source is here. Several niche guides give the same sizing numbers (400–600W solar, 200–400Ah LiFePO4, DC-DC charger), but none of them tested anything. That puts it above open and below saturated.
